content: Awař n Arebbi d Tafawt d Tudart
Deg umezwaru tuɣa iǧa Wawař, Awař tuɣa-t ɣar AREBBI u AREBBI tuɣa-t d Awař.
Wanita d wenni iǧan ɣar AREBBI deg umezwaru.
Zzayes Netta iǧa kuřci u břa Netta war teǧi uřa d ict n tmesřact zi marra min iǧan.
Dayes i teǧa Tudart u Tudart teǧa Tafawt n iwdan.
Tafawt tareqq di taǧest, taǧest war tt tᵉṭṭif.
Tuɣa din ijj n bnadem issekk i-t-i-dd AREBBI, qqaren as Yuḥanna.
Netta yusa-dd am ccahed ḥima ad iched i Tfawt, ḥima ad zzayes amnen marra.
Netta war iǧi ca d Tafawt, maca tuɣa-t ḥima ad iched i Tfawt.
Maɣar Tafawt nni, tuɣa d Tafawt n tidett i itticen tafawt i kuř bnadem i dd-ittasen ɣar ddunect.
Netta tuɣa-t di ddunect u zzayes tᵉttwagg ddunect, maca ddunect war t tessin ca.
Yusa-dd ɣar wi iǧan nnes, maca wi iǧan nnes war t qbiřen.
Maca marra inni t iqebřen, iwca asen ṣṣulṭa, ḥima ad dewřen d tarwa n AREBBI, i yinni ittamnen deg Yisem nnes,
inni war dd-ixřiqen uřa zeg idammen, uřa zi min ixs ddat n bnadem, uřa zi min ixs weryaz, maca zi AREBBI dd-ittwaxeřqen.
Awař idweř d ddat, izdeɣ jar aneɣ, neccin neẓra aɛuǧi nnes, aɛuǧi n Uyenni n Mmis zi ɣar Babas i iccuren s arḍa d tidett.
Iched xas Yuḥanna, iřaɣa, inna: “D Wa min xef nniɣ, aqa Netta ad dd-yas awarni ayi, waxxa Netta idweř zzati, minzi Netta tuɣa-t qbeř inu.”
Zi řekmařet nnes niwi-dd marra, arḍa x arḍa.
Ccariɛa temmewc x ufus n Musa, maca arḍa d tidett usin-dd zi Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Uřa d ijj war iẓri AREBBI. Ayenni n AREBBI i iǧan deg weḥsin n Babas, d Netta i zzayes issxebbaren.
Cchadet tamezwarut n Yuḥanna Amseɣḍaṣ
Ta d cchadet n Yuḥanna řami dd-ssekken Wudayen ikehhanen d Ilawiyyen zi Urcalim ḥima ad t sseqsan: “Min teɛnid cek?”
Tuɣa iched, war issnuffar ca, iched: “Necc war ǧiɣ ca d Lmasiḥ.”
Sseqsan t: “I min teɛnid cek xenni? Ma d cek d anabi Iliya?” Inna: “Lla, war ǧiɣ d necc!” “Ma d cek d anabi?” Yarra-dd: “Lla!”
Xas uca nnan as: “Min teɛnid cek? Ittxeṣṣa aneɣ ad narr i yinni d aneɣ dd-issekken. Min teqqared x yixef nnec?”
Inna: “Necc d tmijja i ittřaɣan di řexřa: ‘Seggmem abrid n SIDI nican!’, am mammec inna unabi Icaɛya.”
Inni dd-ittwassekken, tuɣa aten zeg Ifarisiyyen.
Nitni sseqsan t, nnan as: “Mařa war teǧid ca d Lmasiḥ uřa d Iliya uřa d anabi, i xenni mayemmi tᵉsseɣḍaṣed?”
Yuḥanna yarra-dd, inna asen: “Necc sseɣḍaṣeɣ deg waman, maca aqa din di řwesṭ nwem wenni war tessinem ca.
Netta d wenni i dd ɣa yasen awarni ayi, Netta iǧa qbeř inu, necc war sdiheǧeɣ ad as fesyeɣ ifiřan n sandaliyat nnes.”
Man aya imsar di Baytɛanya x ujemmaḍ n L’Urdun, mani tuɣa Yuḥanna isseɣḍaṣ.
Tiwecca nnes iẓra Yuḥanna Yasuɛ iggur-dd ɣares, inna: “Xzarem, aqa-t d Izmar n AREBBI i ittekksen ddnub x ddunect!
D Wa min xef nniɣ: ‘Ad dd-yas awarni ayi ijj n Weryaz nni iǧan zzati, minzi Netta tuɣa-t qbeř inu.’
Necc war t ssineɣ ca, maca ḥima ad ittwassargeb ɣar Israil, x uyenni usiɣ-dd ḥima ad ssɣeḍṣeɣ deg waman.”
Yuḥanna iched, inna: “Ẓriɣ Arruḥ ihwa-dd am yict n tedbirt zeg ujenna, tarsa xas.
Necc war t ssineɣ ca, maca wenni d ayi dd-issekken ḥima ad ssɣeḍṣeɣ deg waman, Netta inna ayi: ‘Wenni teẓrid ihwa-dd xas Arruḥ uca yarsa xas, d Wa d wenni isseɣḍaṣen di Arruḥ Iqeddsen.’
U Necc ẓriɣ, cehdeɣ belli Wanita d Mmis n AREBBI.”
Imeḥḍaren imezwura n Yasuɛ
Tiwecca nnes tuɣa Yuḥanna ibedd ak-d tnayen n imeḥḍaren nnes.
Am tuɣa ixezzar ɣar Yasuɛ i din igguren, inna: “Xzarem, d Wa d Izmar n AREBBI!”
Tnayen n imeḥḍaren nnes sřin as am tt iqqar uca ḍfaren Yasuɛ.
Inneqřeb-dd Yasuɛ, iẓra i-ten ḍeffaren t-i-dd, isseqsa ten: “Min xef tarezzum?” Nitni nnan as: “A Amseřmad nneɣ, mani tzeddɣed?”
Inna asen: “Araḥem-dd, ad tẓarem!” Ruḥen akides, ẓrin mani izdeɣ, qqimen akides ass nni. Tasaɛɛet tuɣa-tt ɛřaḥař d ɛecra, ixs ad yini ɛřaḥař tasaɛɛet wiss arebɛa n tmeddit.
Andrawus, umas n Cimɛun, tuɣa-t d ijjen zeg yinni isřin aya zi Yuḥanna uca ḍeffaren Yasuɛ.
D wa i iẓrin amezwaru umas Cimɛun, inna as: “Aqa nufa Lmasiḥ!”
Issiweḍ i-t-i-dd ɣar Yasuɛ. Ixzar dayes Yasuɛ, inna: “Cek d Cimɛun, mmis n Yuna, ad ac řaɣan: ‘Kifa’, ixs ad yini ‘aẓru’ ”
Tiwecca nnes tuɣa ixs Yasuɛ ad iraḥ ɣar Ljalil. Immeřqa ak-d Filippus, inna as: “Ḍfar ayi-dd!”
Filippus s yixef nnes tuɣa zi Bayt-Ṣayda zi tandint n Andrawus d Cimɛun.
Filippus yufa Natanayil, inna as: “Nufa wenni xef yura Musa di Ccariɛa uřa d Inabiyyen, aqa-t d Yasuɛ, mmis n Yusuf zi Nnaṣira.”
Natanayil inna as: “Ma ad taɣ izemmar ad dd-teffeɣ zi Nnaṣira ca n tcuni?” Filippus inna as: “Araḥ-dd, texzared!”
Yasuɛ iẓra Natanayil iggur-dd ɣares, inna xas: “Xzar, wa d ijj n mmis d tidett n Israil nni war dayes bu řɣecc!”
Natanayil inna as: “Manis d ayi tessned?” Yasuɛ inna as: “Ẓriɣ cek swadday i wartu qbeř ma ad ac dd-iřaɣa Filippus.”
Natanayil yarra-dd xas: “A Amseřmad inu, Cek d Mmis n AREBBI, Cek d Ajeǧid n Israil.”
Yasuɛ inna as: “Ma tumned s minzi d ac nniɣ: ‘Aqa ẓriɣ cek swadday i wartu’? Ad tẓared min iǧan ktar zi man aya.”
Inna as: “S tidett, s tidett, Necc ad awem iniɣ, zi ssa d tsawent ad tẓarem ajenna innurzem u lmalakat n AREBBI ttařyent hekkwant ɣar Mmis n bnadem!”

footnotes.text: Kifa- isem wanita d isem nnes s Tramit, u ‘Buṭrus’ d isem nnes s Tyunanit, minzi iwdan di temmurt di řweqt nni, tuɣa ssiwřen s Tramit, maca Tyunanit d iřes n Iyunaniyyen inni tuɣa ṣṣelṭen di temmurt ɣar ijj n řweqt qbeř dd-yusin Irumaniyyen.
